lines.en: Excuse me. Can I see the menu, please?
lines.ko: 실례해요. 메뉴판 좀 볼 수 있어요?

lines.en: Of course, Ma'am. Here is the menu.
I will order the fish and rice.
Good. Do you want soup too?
Yes, please. My grandson ate here last week.
lines.ko: 네, 주세요. 제 손자가 지난주에 여기서 먹었어요.

lines.en: I remember him. I served him soup then.
Great. Please bring the bill after the meal.
Sure. The food will come soon.
Thank you. Do people leave a tip here?
No tip is needed, Ma'am. Enjoy your meal.
lines.ko: 팁은 필요 없어요, 손님. 맛있게 드세요.

lines.en: The fish was delicious today. Thank you.
Thank you. Did you like the rice?
Yes. And you are so kind to us.
Thank you. Did you enjoy your meal?
Yes, I'm very full. Can I have the bill, please?
Here it is. We serve guests free tea today.
lines.ko: 여기 있어요. 오늘은 손님들께 차를 무료로 드려요.

lines.en: Wow, thank you. Here is a small tip.
That's very kind. Will you come again?
Yes. I will bring my family next Sunday.
We will wait for you. See you, Ma'am.
